Flooded Road Environments Dataset (FRED)
	

This autonomous vehicle dataset has been developed to enable research into the detection of flooded roads during on-road deployment. The dataset was collected using a Renault Zoe with custom modifications to enable autonomy, including front and rear Blackfly cameras, an Ouster OS1 LiDAR, and a GNSS-corrected IMU.
